instructions: Create one compact Character Look Sheet containing exactly one character and one unchanged outfit.
Show three clearly separated full-body views in one row: neutral front view, exact side view facing viewer-right, and complete back view, all at the same scale.
Include one neutral canonical face crop below the three views while preserving the same identity, apparent age, proportions, hairstyle, skin tone and garment construction in every view.
Use a neutral relaxed A-pose, even studio illumination, a plain light background and generous margins around every complete figure.
Treat the supplied target wardrobe contract as authoritative: preserve every named garment, silhouette, color, material, closure, layer, footwear item and accessory consistently across all views.

The Character identity reference controls identity and body proportions only. Never copy a casting uniform, neutral fitting basics, plain T-shirt and shorts, underwear-like clothing or any incidental source outfit unless the target wardrobe contract explicitly requests it.
Do not add text, labels, measurements, logos, watermark, props, scenery, expression grids, duplicate people, beauty retouching or a T-pose.

generationStyles.realistic: Rendering style: realistic. Use photorealistic surfaces, natural skin texture and physically plausible fabric detail.
generationStyles.semi_realistic: Rendering style: semi-realistic. Use gently simplified surface detail and softly illustrated shading while retaining natural anatomy and recognizable facial features.
generationStyles.illustration: Rendering style: illustration. Use deliberate drawn contours, simplified surface texture and illustrated color shading while retaining recognizable facial features and authored body proportions.

styleAuthority: The selected rendering style controls visual treatment across every view and the face crop, including when the source references or wardrobe descriptions use a different visual treatment. It does not change identity, apparent age, skin tone, body proportions or the target outfit.
